term: first exemplification and caused first instance in A4
definition: A4P2’s first-instance context concerns the first occurrence of one or more bearers having P; one title explicitly includes first time and another omits that phrase. A4C applies this to a nonrigid first occurrence of some contingent things, preceded by none. Causing first exemplification concerns the first event, not merely a later caused P-bearer. Separate first-instance and caused-instance possibilities need not share histories, bearers or causes.
note: Temporal order, existing concrete causal bearer, fixed property intension and first-event correspondence remain OPEN when applying this source reading to a typed framework. The main A4C event title preserves essential before/after states; no universal first-instantiation theorem is introduced.
